title: Kehti Thi Roke Madar Aajou Run Se Asghar
body:
Kehti Thi Roke Madar Aajou Run Se Asghar
Tum Bin Jeungi Kyun Kar Aajou Run Se Asghar
1.Khaima Hai Suna Suna Kisku Jhulao Jhula
Aarasta Hai Bistar Aajou Run Se Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Nanhe Gaale Pe Tumne Maqtal Me Teer Khaya
Hai Jakm Mere Dil Par Aajou Run Se Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Jhule Ke Pass Aakar Nazrou Se Dhudhti Hu
Roti Hai Tumku Khahar Aajou Run Se Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Gardan Pe Teer Khakar Kis Tarha Tum Hasse They
Maa Ku Dikhou Haskar Aajou Run Se Asghar
